Native tactile textures and unread small date lettering are not a full current statutory version or exact colour-key certificate. Complete primary G.S.144-1 read: blue hoist, centred white star, N/C lettering, red upper and white lower equally sized fly bars, fly-bar horizontal length equal to hoist height,3:2 overall field and both dated inscriptions. The introduced300\u00d7200mm field gives a100\u00d7200hoist and200\u00d7100fly bars, derived from the stated field/fly relation. Star outer/inner radii16.5/7.5mm and one-point-up orientation are independently selected teaching geometry; no definitive legal interpretation of the circle-containing-the-same star/letter metric. Required letters and dated scrolls are excluded entirely; this is an explicitly partial independent named pattern/colour-role lesson, not a full official flag or historical wordless flag. No official source image is imported or altered. Retain red-over-white fly order. Similar blue-hoist/white-star templates do not make this the Texas lesson: Texas has the reverse fly colour order; learned colour roles must remain externally taught and actual tactile encodings distinct.
